snippet.title: Eldritch Empathy | Trailer | Coming 2027
snippet.description:
Something stirs behind the veil of reality. Unravel the secrets of otherworldly entities in Eldritch Empathy, an upcoming Lovecraftian narrative horror game. Solve puzzles, research the unknown, and try to maintain your sanity at all costs!

Coming 2027 to Steam.

*Wishlist now on Steam: https://bit.ly/ST-EldritchEmpathy*
 
Follow Eldritch Empathy on Twitter - https://twitter.com/lual_games
Follow Eldritch Empathy on Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/eldritch_empathy/
Follow Eldritch Empathy on TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@lual.games

Join the Eldritch Empathy Discord - https://discord.gg/qtvwdZjcvy

*About Team17:*
Founded in 1990, Team17 is a leading developer, video games label, and creative partner for developers around the world. Team17’s portfolio of multi-award-winning and award-nominated in-house brands include Hell Let Loose, Golf With Your Friends, The Escapists, and the iconic Worms franchise, alongside its games label partner titles, including the award-winning games Blasphemous, DREDGE and Overcooked! franchise. Visit https://www.team17.com/ for more information.
